direction: Daily Ultimate Oscillator level momentum,unlevered spot long/cash.
hypothesis: Combine gap-aware buying-pressure/true-range ratios overN/2N/4N to test sustained positive momentum with a fixed lower exit. This level-rule hypothesis is not the source authors retrospective divergence method or profitability evidence.

rule.signal: Aggregate UTC daily H/L/lastC from1440closed minutes. BP_j=C_j-min(L_j,C_prev);TR_j=max(H_j,C_prev)-min(L_j,C_prev). A_m=sum(BP)/sum(TR) overm*Ndays endingj,for m1/2/4;if period sumTRexactly0,that ratio0. UO=100*(4*A1+2*A2+A4)/7. First valid index4N,needs prior close.4/2/1are fixed indicator weights;divisor7is formula,not capital-weight normalization. Exact Fraction from dailyFloat64decimal strings,Decimal60display andcanonical ratioSHA. Original accountingDecimal28. No retrospective divergence,seed orfoldreset.
rule.entry: When flat,enter iff UO>E;strict boundary,no prior-cross requirement,including first OOS decision.
rule.exit: When long,exit iff UO<45;equality45keeps long. AllzeroTR UO0exits. No short,hold cap or same-decision re-entry;costed terminal liquidation.
rule.execution: Signal becomes available at the signal candle close; if target changes, simulate an order at the next UTC day 00:01 one-minute open (60-second delay). Rejected orders are not backfilled; the same desired state may be tried on a later new daily decision. At the frozen OOS terminal timestamp, liquidate any open lot with costs.
rule.account: Independent 2,000 USDT single-asset cash account for every asset×parameter combination; all initial capital assigned to the specified asset sleeve, no leverage, borrowing, shorting, transfer or cash interest.

time_boundaries.walk_forward: 12 consecutive, non-overlapping 30-day evaluation windows; account remains continuous across windows; no fitting, parameter selection or fold reset.
time_boundaries.history_note: The 2025–2026 OOS window has been reused extensively in this repository and is not an untouched final holdout.

validation.neighborhood: Same asset, adjacent lookback index and adjacent hurdle index in the frozen 3×3 grid; 3×3 neighborhood including center.
validation.multiple_testing: No DSR/PBO claim: repeated reused-OOS history and many prior strategy trials create material selection bias.
validation.purging: No fitted model or future-return labels;label purge inapplicable.4Ncomplete BP/TR observations require4N+1daily prices;first valid index4N. No future padding,seed,OOS/fold reset or parameter selection.365day context and3day initial gap precede12continuous folds.
validation.continuous_drawdown: Initial capital plus all OOS minute-close and immediate post-fill marks; no fold reset or intraminute extrema.

costs.impact: 0.5 × sample stdev of previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns × sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete daily quote ADV)
